_about: Settings for the fact sheets (engine/profiles/: build.py, walk_grid.py, fetch_walk.py, fetch_drive.py, page.html): one per local area, plus the University Endowment Lands (unit 24, beside the City, not part of it). 'The subway' here is SkyTrain (skytrain_stations, skytrain_lines; the SeaBus is drawn with it, as on TransLink's map); stops and changes to the hubs are counted along each drawn line, with a change wherever two stations sit within 200 m (Waterfront's Expo and Canada Line platforms). The headline transit time is the map's own To Waterfront (la_profiles.json 'waterfront'). The West Coast Express is the regional rail. Parking rows are EV charging only (parking.geojson, from cities/vancouver/parking.py). factsheet.css colours the line bullets in TransLink's colours (cities/vancouver/city.css).

page.description: Printable one-page fact sheets for each of Vancouver’s 22 local areas and the University Endowment Lands: SkyTrain, buses, the West Coast Express, highways, drive times, EV charging, parks, libraries, bikeways and Mobi. Drop a pin for walk and drive times from any spot.
